facts.fact: The Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation's InfoHighway page says the data-sharing platform has been live since August 2016, letting government agencies share data at runtime from publishers' databases to subscribing agencies.
The page counts 33 publishers, 192 connections and 628 e-services on InfoHighway; the counts carry no date, so the published date is used.
The page reports 816,723,627 total queries to date, 169,549 this month and 217,861 the previous month on InfoHighway; the figures carry no date, so the published date is used.

systems.platform: Publish and subscribe service platform with portal, web services and bulk transfer, hosted at the Government Online Centre on the Government Intranet
systems.owner: Ministry of Information Technology, Communication and Innovation (project owner); Central Informatics Bureau (project management)
